listing.name: Project Arondight
listing.aiSummary: Adds a crewed mech super-frigate with upgradeable systems and mission-based progression.

description:
Project Arondight

Quote

The lattice grows.

Fly an upgradeable mech super-frigate!

A crewed mech super-frigate, recovered from a derelict research habitat, and the missions around it. The mech can be upgraded through a variety of missions and skill tree choices.

Minor spoilers for [THREAT].

Arma Armatura is supported but not required.

Screenshots

Minor THREAT Spoilers

[close]

FAQ

How do I get started?

Go to any bar, or if you are using Nexerelin select the start.

Is this balanced?

Kind of. It's pretty strong, comparable to things like Excelsior, but it is only a single ship. Maybe about as balanced as UAF.

Dependencies/Incompatibilities/Supported mods?

This mod actually shouldn't require any other mods. It also should be compatible with every other mod. If you run into any issues, let me know!

If you use a mod that modifies the bottom bar and the "Manage" button doesn't show up next to command, you can change the setting to make this mod appear as an intel entry.

It does have support for LunaSettings and Console Commands, but they are not required. Arma Armatura is supported but also not required. If it is present, the hullmod for strikecraft will be present on the mech.

I want to change the balance!

Use the LunaSettings menu to adjust these options.

Future plans?

Currently feature complete! There may be future content or balance or bugfixing updates though.

Can be added to existing saves?

I think so! Save before to be sure. Probably can't be removed though.

Changelog

Refer to changelog link above.

Credits

Thanks to people on the Unofficial discord for their thoughts and suggestions!

Thanks to other mod makers for providing inspiration, and to Alex, David, et al. for making Starsector.

AI generation was used for: most of the images (Nano Banana and Ideogram), and for coding.
